content.value: Tense indicates the time of an action along with its degree of completeness.
परीक्षा टिप्स: सेतु श्रृंखला के मुख्य सूत्रों और बिंदुओं को बार-बार दोहराएं।

mcqs.question: Identify the tense: She has completed her assignment.
mcqs.explanation: has + past participle (V3) indicates Present Perfect.
